# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

  * [PortraitNOVARES® hydrocarbon resins were first developed in the 1960s at our production

  * [Rain Carbon Inc.RAIN Carbon Inc. with its NOVARES product range has been part of the holding

  * [Indene-Coumarone-Resins (C Series)Carbon based indene-coumarone resins from NOVARES improve the
    properties of numerous products, i.a. from the adhesive, damping and rubber industry][11]
  * [Hydrocarbon Resins (T Series)Petro based hydrocarbon resins of the NOVARES T series help to
    produce safe and high quality products, i.a. in the adhesive industry and in road
    construction.][12]
  * [Modifiers (L and H Series)The NOVARES resins of the L and H series are used as modifiers and
    improve adhesion and corrosion protection properties of various products.][13]
  * [Hydrogenated Hydrocarbon ResinsNOVARES pure resins are produced with a well-controlled
    molecular design and a highly efficient hydrogenation and purifying process. They are based on
    C9 or DCPD/C9 Monomers. Due to the precursor structure, the NOVARES pure series of water-white
    resins provide a range of polymer compatibilities and can fulfil the requirements of a broad
    spectrum of applications.][14]

# The Best in Tackifier Resins and Acrylic Monomers

## **Resin and Monomer Solutions with Reliable Supply**

We are a team of ***tackifier resin and acrylic monomer specialists ***providing the best in
technical and supply solutions.  

With in-depth expertise, the widest tackifier range in the industry, and diverse monomer sourcing
options, our product selection guidance assures a comprehensive understanding of sourcing choices
available to meet both performance and cost requirements. 

[][18]

TECKROS**^{®}**

TECKREZ^{®}

TECKSTAR**^{®}**

TECKROS**^{®}**

TECKWAX™

MONTECK**^{®}**

#### Bio-Based Resin

Bio-based resins, like rosin and terpene derivatives, have a wide range of applications such as in
packaging materials, automotive parts, adhesive, coating, and construction materials.

#### HYDROCARBON RESIN

A class of thermoplastic resins derived from petroleum. Used in applications such as adhesives,
coating, printing ink, rubber compounding, and more.

#### Acrylic resin

Homopolymers or copolymers of various methacrylic and acrylic monomers, designed as coating resin
for solid surfaces, acrylic coatings, acrylic adhesives, and paints.

[][19]

#### [Dispersions][20]

In rosin ester dispersions, the rosin esters are finely dispersed in water with the help of a
surfactant.

[][21]

#### [WAX][22]

A high-purity synthetic wax via Fischer-Tropsch, offering low viscosity, consistent performance,
narrow melting range.

#### MONOMERS

Teckrez offers a full suite of monomers including [Acrylamides][23], [Acrylates][24],
[Methacrylates][25], and [Specialty Monomers][26].


### **Product Categories by TECKREZ^{®}**

**TECKROS^{®}**  Product name for rosin resins, made from pine tree derivatives

**TECKREZ^{®}**  Product name for our hydrocarbon resins, all made from petroleum feedstocks

**TECKSTAR^{®}**  Product name for our acrylic resins, all made from acrylic and methacrylic
monomers

**MONTECK^{®}**  Product name for our monomer products, including acrylate, methacrylate,
acrylamide, and other specialty monomers

**TECKWAX™ **A high-purity synthetic wax via Fischer-Tropsch, offering low viscosity, consistent
performance, narrow melting range.

[][27]

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# Performance Materials für Sie entwickelt.

## RAHN-Gruppe

Die RAHN-Gruppe entwickelt und vertreibt Performance Materials für hochspezialisierte Industrien.
Die beiden Geschäftsbereiche EnergyCuring und Cosmetics bedienen Märkte der Oberflächenbeschichtung
und der Kosmetik. Wir sind stolz auf unsere lange Tradition als Familienunternehmen, ein
verantwortungsvolles Geschäftsgebaren und unseren professionellen Servicegedanken. Als Gruppe von
acht Unternehmen mit 130 Mitarbeitenden auf drei Kontinenten sind wir ein globales Unternehmen, aber
immer noch klein genug, um uns um die individuellen Anliegen aller unserer Geschäftspartner zu
kümmern.

### Get involved

Designing Buildings is a Wiki site - written by its users for its users. We rely on you to add new
content and edit and improve existing content.

You can write about any subject related to the construction industry, including guidance, research,
theories, legislation, news, products and practices. All we ask is that articles are factual (not
adverts) and are encyclopaedic in style (not blog posts).

[[Find out more button 350.png]][73]

[[DBi call to action 350.png]][74]

We're expanding our collaborative mission by launching DB Intelligence, an exclusive market research
advisory panel. Built environment professionals can now get paid to share their expertise on
industry trends, products and services.

surveys, 1-2-1 interviews and focus groups. Participation will be flexible, with opportunities
designed to fit around professional schedules.

This is intended to be practical, relevant and worthwhile: a chance to influence industry thinking
while being rewarded for your time.

hear from you.

you with satisfactory solutions with enthusiasm and professionalism. We look forward to
collaborating with you to create a brighter future.
If you have any questions or require further information about our business, please feel free to
contact us. Thank you!

    properties of numerous products, i.a. from the adhesive, damping and rubber industry][11]
  * [Hydrocarbon Resins (T Series)Petro based hydrocarbon resins of the NOVARES T series help to
    produce safe and high quality products, i.a. in the adhesive industry and in road
    construction.][12]

    improve adhesion and corrosion protection properties of various products.][13]

    C9 or DCPD/C9 Monomers. Due to the precursor structure, the NOVARES pure series of water-white
    resins provide a range of polymer compatibilities and can fulfil the requirements of a broad
    spectrum of applications.][14]

sciences, water treatment, environmental protection, power, mining and food/beverage applications.

## Applications

### Bioprocessing

Bioprocessing is a crucial aspect of biotechnology that involves the use of living cells, enzymes,
and biological systems to produce valuable products, including pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and
monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). This field encompasses a range of techniques and methodologies aimed
at the efficient extraction, purification, and formulation of biomolecules.
[Learn More][105]

### Small Molecule Purification

At Sunresin, we specialize in high-performance chromatography resins that are essential for the
purification of a wide variety of molecules. Our synthetic and dextran chromatography resins are
tailored for applications in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and chemical industries, ensuring that
you achieve optimal results in your purification processes.
[Learn More][106]

### Solid Phase Synthesis

At Sunresin, we specialize in providing high-quality resins for the solid phase synthesis of
peptides and oligonucleotides. Our innovative resin solutions empower researchers and manufacturers
to achieve efficient and reliable synthesis, enhancing productivity and purity in your projects.
[Learn More][107]

### Enzyme Catalysis

We provide innovative enzyme carriers designed for efficient enzyme immobilization, enabling you to
optimize biocatalytic processes across various industries. Our extensive range of enzyme carriers
ensures that you achieve high stability, activity, and ease of use in your applications.
[Learn More][108]

# The Best in Tackifier Resins and Acrylic Monomers

## **Resin and Monomer Solutions with Reliable Supply**

We are a team of ***tackifier resin and acrylic monomer specialists ***providing the best in
technical and supply solutions.  

With in-depth expertise, the widest tackifier range in the industry, and diverse monomer sourcing
options, our product selection guidance assures a comprehensive understanding of sourcing choices
available to meet both performance and cost requirements. 

[][18]

TECKROS**^{®}**

TECKREZ^{®}

TECKSTAR**^{®}**

TECKROS**^{®}**

TECKWAX™

MONTECK**^{®}**

#### Bio-Based Resin

Bio-based resins, like rosin and terpene derivatives, have a wide range of applications such as in
packaging materials, automotive parts, adhesive, coating, and construction materials.

#### HYDROCARBON RESIN

A class of thermoplastic resins derived from petroleum. Used in applications such as adhesives,
coating, printing ink, rubber compounding, and more.

#### Acrylic resin

Homopolymers or copolymers of various methacrylic and acrylic monomers, designed as coating resin
for solid surfaces, acrylic coatings, acrylic adhesives, and paints.

[][19]

#### [Dispersions][20]

In rosin ester dispersions, the rosin esters are finely dispersed in water with the help of a
surfactant.

[][21]

#### [WAX][22]

A high-purity synthetic wax via Fischer-Tropsch, offering low viscosity, consistent performance,
narrow melting range.

#### MONOMERS

Teckrez offers a full suite of monomers including [Acrylamides][23], [Acrylates][24],
[Methacrylates][25], and [Specialty Monomers][26].


### **Product Categories by TECKREZ^{®}**

**TECKROS^{®}**  Product name for rosin resins, made from pine tree derivatives

**TECKREZ^{®}**  Product name for our hydrocarbon resins, all made from petroleum feedstocks

**TECKSTAR^{®}**  Product name for our acrylic resins, all made from acrylic and methacrylic
monomers

**MONTECK^{®}**  Product name for our monomer products, including acrylate, methacrylate,
acrylamide, and other specialty monomers

**TECKWAX™ **A high-purity synthetic wax via Fischer-Tropsch, offering low viscosity, consistent
performance, narrow melting range.

[][27]

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

We are an Italian company specializing in producing **high-quality castable resins** for 3D
printing. Our resins are meticulously formulated to provide exceptional results for jewelry
professionals and enthusiasts alike. We guarantee a fast and clean burnout, ensuring perfect casting
results every time, with minimal ash residue and exceptional detail reproduction. All our products
are rigorously tested in our casting department.

BlueCast has been a leading manufacturer of high-quality castable resins since 2008. With a presence
in over 40 countries, we have established strong partnerships with more than 50 major resellers,
distributing resin specifically for the jewelry industry. Our expertise and commitment have
positioned us as a respected castable resin manufacturer, with over 15 years of industry leadership.
Every year, we have produced and supplied over 30 tons of resin, processing and delivering hundreds
of kilograms every day. Our extensive customer base, consisting of over 20,000 satisfied clients, is
a testament to our dedication to providing the best after-sales assistance.

**Sustainability** is a core value at BlueCast, and we take pride in offering the only castable
resin suitable for a one-hour burnout process. We prioritize the needs of companies of all sizes and
are eager to explore how we can support your specific requirements.

prosperity.

## REASONS WHY OUR RESINS ARE THE BEST ONES

Are you looking for a 3D printing resin to make jewelry?
Discover BlueCast Advantages:

### 1. QUALITY

Since 2008, BlueCast has focused on manufacturing and developing high performance castable resins
specifically for the jewelry industry. All our products are certified as 100% made in Italy and are
dedicated to professional users.

### 2. 100% SAFE

Our castable resins are completely safe for users, and X10 is the first resin that is 100% free of
monomers.

### 3. SUSTAINABLE

One of our main goals is to make the casting process more sustainable. Our latest castable resin can
be cast with an ultra-fast burnout cycle of only 1 or 2 hour in according to the flask size, whereas
traditional wax burnout requires a minimum of 7 hours. This translates to an energy use or cost
reduction of more than 60-70%.

### 4. HIGH WAX CONTENT

Our resins feature a high content of waxy polymers, ensuring smooth casting and minimizing
shrinkage, resulting in precise and dimensionally accurate jewelry pieces.

### 5. EASY TO USE

Whether you are an experienced jeweler or just beginning your 3D printing journey, our resins are
exceptionally user-friendly and deliver consistent results without the need for lengthy and complex
post-curing. We developed the first resin that requires no post-curing.

### 6. VERSATILE APPLICATIONS

Beyond jewelry, our resins are ideal for a variety of applications, including dentistry, medical
devices, and other lost-wax casting processes.

### About

Designing Buildings is the construction wiki. An industry-wide, cross-discipline forum for finding
and sharing knowledge about the planning, design, construction and operation of built assets.

[[2024 infographic.jpg]][63]

[[Find out more button 350.png]][64]

Designing Buildings has [25 knowledge hubs][65] where you can find introductions to our main subject
areas and links to key articles that will help you learn more

[[Knowledge hubs 350.png]][66]

The site also includes 6 microsites - mini wikis about specialist subjects. Created with our
partners, they provide easy access to curated knowledge about particular aspects of the built
environment:

[[Conservation wiki 350.png]][67]

[[BIM wiki 350.png]][68]

[[People wiki 350.png]][69]

[[AONB wiki 350.png]][70]

[[Building safety wiki button 350.png]][71]

[[Circular economy wiki button.png]][72]

### Get involved

Designing Buildings is a Wiki site - written by its users for its users. We rely on you to add new
content and edit and improve existing content.

You can write about any subject related to the construction industry, including guidance, research,
theories, legislation, news, products and practices. All we ask is that articles are factual (not
adverts) and are encyclopaedic in style (not blog posts).

[[Find out more button 350.png]][73]

[[DBi call to action 350.png]][74]

We're expanding our collaborative mission by launching DB Intelligence, an exclusive market research
advisory panel. Built environment professionals can now get paid to share their expertise on
industry trends, products and services.

Members receive direct financial incentives for participating in research projects like short
surveys, 1-2-1 interviews and focus groups. Participation will be flexible, with opportunities
designed to fit around professional schedules.

This is intended to be practical, relevant and worthwhile: a chance to influence industry thinking
while being rewarded for your time.

If you would like to be considered for the DB Intelligence advisory panel, we would be delighted to
hear from you.

Register today to shape the future of the construction sector.

Who We Serve?

### R&D Decision Makers

We provide R&D decision makers with access to accurate, connected data so they can quickly
understand important technology trends, identify the competitive threats, uncover partnership
opportunities, and decide the direction of innovation.

### New Product Innovation Leader

We help Innovation teams discover the emerging technology areas, evaluate technological maturity,
validate new ideas, and find the gaps in the market!

### Technology Research Analysts

We accelerate the research process for Technology Research Analysts through automated analysis of
millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.
Why Discovery?

### Technology Intelligence Data Foundation

Discovery brings company, patent, literature, investment, M&A, news, and research funding together
in one platform. Powered by AI and machine learning, the platform is continually updated with the
latest global data points.These connected insights provide a meaningful foundation for you to
analyze and make sense of market trends, disruptive technology, the competitive landscape, and more.

### Technology Classification and Company Innovation Indicators

With our technology classification and ranking system, we help you quickly understand a company's
R&D strategy through patent portfolio and technology roadmap visualizations. This data empowers you
to measure a company’s innovation capability, technical influence, innovation originality, scale,
and stability.

* [
  
  
  #### Global Leader in 3D Printing Materials
  
  eSUN is renowned for its balance of quality and affordability, making it one of the world’s
  leading manufacturers of 3D printing materials. With a product range spanning PLA, ABS, PETG,
  Nylon, TPU, and more, eSUN has earned recognition from global media and industry awards, trusted
  by both hobbyists and professionals.
  
  [Global Leader in 3D Printing Materials] ][140]
* [
  
  
  #### Accessories and Complete Printing Support
  
  Beyond materials, eSUN offers complementary printing accessories like the eBox filament dryer and
  eVacuum storage kit to keep filaments dry, tangle-free, and performance-ready. Detailed print
  parameters and guides are also provided, helping users quickly get started and optimize results —
  from hobbyists to professional makers.
  
  [Accessories and Complete Printing Support] ][141]
* [
  
  
  #### Comprehensive Resin Portfolio
  
  eSUN’s resin lineup includes standard, tough, ABS-like, high-speed, and water-washable options,
  catering to functional prototypes, mechanical parts, and aesthetic creations. Tough resin rivals
  ABS+ in durability, ABS-like resins match traditional ABS filaments, HS100 enables up to 72%
  faster printing, and water-washable resins simplify post-processing.
  
  [Comprehensive Resin Portfolio] ][142]
* [
  
  
  #### Versatile High-Performance Filaments
  
  eSUN’s PLA+ combines high strength with ease of printing, making it ideal for general 3D printing.
  PETG offers excellent layer adhesion, impact resistance, and low shrinkage, perfect for functional
  parts. ABS+ features improved stability and heat resistance, while the TPU series ranges from firm
  to soft options, catering to flexible designs and rubber-like applications.
  
  [Versatile High-Performance Filaments] ][143]

About Sunresin
Sunresin is a global leader in the innovation, development and production of ion exchange and
adsorbent resins as well as specialty resins for Life Sciences applications, including
chromatography, solid-phase peptide synthesis, catalysis, and APIs/excipients.
 
Serving diverse and highly regulated global industries, Sunresin plays a crucial role in solving
complex purification, separation, and extraction challenges in processes for healthcare, life
sciences, water treatment, environmental protection, power, mining and food/beverage applications.
With over 1400 employees worldwide, cutting-edge R&D, and a strong global footprint, we are at the
forefront of resin technology innovation.

WHAT CAN WE SOLVE

## Applications

### Bioprocessing

Bioprocessing is a crucial aspect of biotechnology that involves the use of living cells, enzymes,
and biological systems to produce valuable products, including pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and
monoclonal antibodies (mAbs). This field encompasses a range of techniques and methodologies aimed
at the efficient extraction, purification, and formulation of biomolecules.
[Learn More][105]

### Small Molecule Purification

At Sunresin, we specialize in high-performance chromatography resins that are essential for the
purification of a wide variety of molecules. Our synthetic and dextran chromatography resins are
tailored for applications in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and chemical industries, ensuring that
you achieve optimal results in your purification processes.
[Learn More][106]

### Solid Phase Synthesis

At Sunresin, we specialize in providing high-quality resins for the solid phase synthesis of
peptides and oligonucleotides. Our innovative resin solutions empower researchers and manufacturers
to achieve efficient and reliable synthesis, enhancing productivity and purity in your projects.
[Learn More][107]

### Enzyme Catalysis

We provide innovative enzyme carriers designed for efficient enzyme immobilization, enabling you to
optimize biocatalytic processes across various industries. Our extensive range of enzyme carriers
ensures that you achieve high stability, activity, and ease of use in your applications.
[Learn More][108]
